# HALLOHOM AI

> HALLOHOM AI helps architects and interior designers source building materials across India. The company also develops Vismayam-V01, a proprietary open-vocabulary interior object detection model for room imagery.

## Canonical site
- https://www.hallohom.com/

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://www.hallohom.com/index.html): AI material intelligence and procurement for architects — share requirements, get quotes, compare options, delivery support.
- [Vismayam-V01](https://www.hallohom.com/vismayam-v01.html): Research page for Vismayam-V01 — zero-shot interior object detection using Parallel Box Decoding (PBD). Early access via contact form.
- [Contact](https://www.hallohom.com/contact.html): Book a demo, WhatsApp, email, office location in India.
- [AI Pilot Program](https://www.hallohom.com/prompt.html): Early-access pilot for architects testing HALLOHOM AI workflows.

## Entity facts
- Legal / brand name: HALLOHOM AI
- Email: hallo@hallohom.com
- Pilot email: pilot@hallohom.com
- WhatsApp: +91 8086207113
- Primary market: India (architects, interior designers, builders)
- Core service: Material sourcing, supplier quotes, procurement support
- AI product: Vismayam-V01 (proprietary, early access only — not publicly open-sourced)

## Vismayam-V01 (summary for citations)
- Type: Interior vision model for open-vocabulary object detection and localization
- Target users: Architects, interior designers, design teams
- Detects: Furniture, tiles, sanitary fixtures, architectural elements from natural-language queries
- Architecture highlights: Native-resolution vision-language encoder, Parallel Box Decoding (PBD)
- Model scale: Approximately 300M–1B parameters (Aug 2026)
- Availability: Early access — request via https://www.hallohom.com/contact.html
- Internal benchmark (same scene, same queries): Vismayam-V01 72 instances / 91% accuracy vs YOLO-World 32 / 84%, Gemini 45 / 68%, OpenAI 20 / 42%
- Extended milestone test: 250 total detections, 88% accuracy on dense interior scenes

## What HALLOHOM AI is NOT
- Not a general-purpose chatbot product
- Vismayam-V01 weights and training data are not publicly released
- Not a replacement for structural engineering or quantity surveying sign-off

## Preferred citation format
HALLOHOM AI — Vismayam-V01: Open Interior Intelligence. https://www.hallohom.com/vismayam-v01.html
